review.heading: Assessment {number}
review.notYoursHint: This review was not sent to you, moved to someone else, or no longer exists. Reviews sent to you arrive as cards in the LINE chat.
review.moduleOff: Supplier risk is switched off for this organization, so this review cannot be opened.

state.RETURNED: This part was returned for changes on {time}
state.CANCELLED: This review was cancelled because another reviewer returned the assessment. There is nothing more to do.
state.cannotDecide: You can read this review but cannot decide it now: the assessment may no longer wait for review, or you opened or filled it in.

questions.title: Questions and answers of your part
questions.hint: Only the general part and the parts you review are shown
questions.empty: This assessment asked no question in your part

source.ON_BEHALF: Filled in by procurement for the supplier

questions.openOnWeb: Open the files on the web

slots.title: Every reviewer's part
slots.hint: Only the state of the other parts is shown, never their answers or reasons

decide.confirmText: Confirm passing assessment {number} for the part you review. This cannot be changed once confirmed.
decide.returnHint: The assessment goes back for changes, and the other reviews still waiting are cancelled.
decide.reasonHint: Say which answers are missing or wrong. Procurement and the auditors read this.
decide.share: This message may go to the supplier
decide.shareHint: Unticked, the supplier does not see this message and only learns that the assessment was returned
decide.confirmReturn: I have checked the reason and understand a return cannot be undone
decide.reasonError: Write the reason for the return, at least 3 characters
decide.signedOut: Your sign-in in LINE has ended and nothing was sent. Load this page again and try once more.
decide.failed: We could not tell whether this reached BCS because the connection failed. Try again; if it was sent, this page shows it after loading again.

errors.done: This review was already done by {name} on {time}
errors.closed: This review is closed: there is nothing more to do.
errors.sod: You cannot review this assessment: you opened or filled it in (separation of duties).
errors.notYours: This review is no longer yours. The page now shows where it stands.
errors.reason: Write the reason for the return, at least 3 characters
errors.moduleOff: Supplier risk is switched off for this organization, so this review cannot be decided.
errors.signedOut: Your sign-in has ended and nothing was sent. Load this page again and try once more.
errors.other: The decision was not saved. Try again; if it still fails, tell your administrator.
